payload.reason: One syntactic match: tests/e2e/cao-mcp-container.mjs:89 await run(chmod -R a+rX, mkdtemp'd directory). The directory only ever holds a copied public dashboard SQLite fixture (no 0o600/restricted-mode file is ever written into it), so widening its permissions has no information-disclosure consequence; this is a false positive against the rule's stated unsafe pattern. No genuine recursive-chmod-over-restricted-file occurrence found elsewhere in JS/TS sources. Smallest fix: scope detection to directories that also contain (or plausibly could contain) a file created with a restrictive mode, e.g. require corroborating evidence of a 0o600/0600 write in the same directory subtree, rather than flagging every recursive chmod call.

regression_case.description: tests/e2e/cao-mcp-container.mjs recursive chmod on an mkdtemp'd directory holding only a public SQLite snapshot copy (no restricted-mode file ever written there) must NOT be flagged once the rule is scoped to restricted-file-bearing directories.

payload.reason: Ran a scratch ESLint rule against dashboard/site/src/components matching the mined pattern (async handler using a createFactoryScope() scope, post-await .set() with no scope.signal.aborted guard). Found 7 unguarded true-positive sites beyond the originally mined evidence: account-menu.js:96,126 (switchAccount/logout busy.set after await, scope present but unused), cli-actions.js:126-131 and 274-286 (both createPromptCliActionControl and the confirm-dialog control write busy/statusText/outputText/confirmLabel after await with no guard despite owning a scope bound via scope.bind), configuration-view.js:310-321 (diagnosticsBusy/diagnosticsStatusText, same finding the candidate's evidence already cited), reset-dashboard-control.js:104-107 (statusMessage/busy.set after the awaited resetLocalDashboardData call, scope present but unused), and data-view.js:1115-1117 (mobile card-list loadMore writes loadState.set after an awaited continuation.load with no boundaryScope.signal.aborted check, unlike the structurally identical and already-guarded swimlane continuation loader at data-view.js:1478). Zero false positives: every correctly guarded sibling (ui-primitives.js createCopyControl, table-region.js continuation loader, data-view.js swimlane consumeEffect) was correctly left unflagged by requiring a <scope>.signal.aborted check reachable from an enclosing createFactoryScope()-bound variable. No unclear diagnostics or autofix proposed (rule has no autofix). Lint performance not separately measured (rule only traverses async function bodies in files already being parsed).

regression_case.description: data-view.js's mobile card-list loadMore() (used when 'lazy-list' is set and no continuation is pre-expanded) must keep flagging: it calls loadState.set({phase:'error',...}) and loadState.set({phase:hidden?'complete':'idle',...}) after `await continuation.load(token)` with no boundaryScope.signal.aborted guard, while the structurally identical swimlane continuation loader in the same file already added the guard. A future fix must add the guard here without also suppressing the correctly-guarded swimlane and table-region.js continuation loaders.
